item.summary: docs(agents): add test-audit authoring gate and net-neutral bug-fix doctrine - Rename openclaw-test-audit skill to test-audit; add an authoring-gate mode invoked whenever tests are written, not only during sweeps. - Repair Doctrine: capture the failing repro before editing; regression tests must fail on pre-fix code. Bug fixes default to net <=0 production LOC via the refactor that absorbs the fix, not a bolted-on guard. - ClawSweeper policy: production-vs-test LOC reviewMetrics entry is now unconditional for code PRs, counted with judgment; net-positive bug-fix deltas become risks findings with bestSolution naming the absorbing refactor.
